status_note: Reproduces on Polars 2.1.0 (Python, macOS arm64); not checked against main or open issues.
summary: A `Date` is an `Int32` of days, but chrono's `NaiveDate` covers only about ±262 000 years. A cast of a larger day count to `Date` succeeds, and then casting it to `String`, printing the frame or reading the value panics (`PanicException: out-of-range date`, from `date32_to_date`'s `expect`) where an error or NULL is expected; `dt.year()` of it is NULL.
repro:
import polars as pl
df = pl.DataFrame({"x": [2**31 - 1]}, schema={"x": pl.Int32}).select(pl.col("x").cast(pl.Date))
df.select(pl.col("x").dt.year()).item()  # None
df.select(pl.col("x").cast(pl.String))  # PanicException: out-of-range date
handling: No Polars profile yet; the characterization records it (polars-date-range). The reference's dates stay within 0001-01-01 … 9999-12-31 (#251), so a guarded plan never builds such a date.
